title: Personal Health, Wellness and Potential
description: An examination of lifestyle behaviours, which have the power to enhance or diminish personal potential. Current wellness models and motivational theories are reviewed and applied to wellness planning as related to personal and professional performance. Topics include physical activity and health; nutrition; stress management; substance use/abuse; environmental awareness; goal setting; and the process of decision-making.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of EPHE 142, PE 142.
